test_compact_ids_pass: test the --compact-ids SPIR-V optimization pass on a given .spv file
test_spirv_file: test a single SPIR-V binary file for correctness of the compact-ids optimization pass
run_compact_ids_test_suite: run the compact-ids test script on multiple .spv files from the command line
print_usage: print usage instructions for the compact-ids test script
verify_spirv_optimization: verify that spirv-opt --compact-ids produces output equivalent to disassemble-reassemble
